detached_structure.evidence: A small white rectangular object sits beside the house at the left, but it is too small and unclear to call a shed. It may be a hot tub cover or a roof feature.

signals.notes: The house is a multi-section, dark gray roof partly ringed by dense mature canopy, with a dark asphalt driveway on the south side and a lawn to the west; the cars at the bottom of the tile appear to belong to the neighboring lot.
